text:
I tell you that grief without hope is grief without passion,

and that only unbelieving men feel pain,

snatched up by anguish, in the night air,

rising toward God's throne shouting spells.

A desert full of souls, naked silence lies

beneath the snowy, vertical eye of absolute Heaven.

The deep-hearted man expresses grief

for his dead in the quietest silence, mute,

like an enormous statue raised in eternal stone,

not moving until he himself lies in the earth.

Touch them: the marble of their eyes never grows wet,

for if it could weep, it might arise and disappear.

translation.title: Grief
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the severe meditation on grief, silence, and unmoving marble.
